name: Wicked Tunnels
summary: The Wicked Tunnels form the subterranean labyrinth beneath Desolace that bridges the surface caves with the depths of Maraudon. Divided into an upper maze of purple crystals and a lower path toward cascading subterranean waters, these passages are teeming with ravenous rock borers and restless earth elementals.

sections.title: The Threshold of Maraudon
sections.body: Carved deep beneath the arid wastes of Desolace, the Wicked Tunnels branch outward from the cavern known as Zaetar's Choice. Venturing into the northern route leads travelers into the upper tunnels, a disorienting, multi-tiered maze of natural stone bridges illuminated by strange purple crystals. Here, tunneling rock borers and protective earth elementals prowl, guarding the path toward Maraudon's Wicked Grotto. Following the eastern passage through Earth Song Gate reveals the lower tunnels: a direct, quieter descent leading straight toward the roar of Earth Song Falls.

faq.q: Where do the Wicked Tunnels lead?
faq.answer: The tunnels serve as the outer entryways into the sacred centaur tomb-city of Maraudon. The upper maze winds toward the Wicked Grotto portal, while the lower branch guides travelers directly to the falls of Earth Song.

faq.q: What creatures dwell within the tunnels?
faq.answer: The cavern walls are crawled by subterranean rock borers and guarded by wandering earth elementals bound to the troubled earth of Desolace.

faq.q: How do you reach the lower Wicked Tunnels?
aliases: how to get to lower wicked tunnels
faq.answer: From the junction at Zaetar's Choice, take the eastern path through the Earth Song Gate. It presents a much shorter, more direct tunnel compared to the winding upper maze.

faq.q: Why are the upper tunnels glowing purple?
aliases: why is it purple in wicked tunnels
faq.answer: The upper caverns are encrusted with clusters of luminescent purple subterranean crystals, casting an eerie glow over the bridges and chasms that lead toward the Wicked Grotto.

angles.text: The chaotic agitation among the resident earth elementals mirrors the deep spiritual wound echoing across the subterranean foundation of Desolace.
The twisting stone caverns and elemental denizens mark these passages as a prime territory for precious subterranean mineral deposits.
